tasks_completed.description: Fixed slug extraction for multi-hyphen destination names
tasks_completed.changes: Changed line 49 from ${BASE_FILENAME%-*} to ${BASE_FILENAME%-${PLAN_DATE}} to strip the exact captured date instead of just the last hyphen segment
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: ${BASE_FILENAME%-*} is a non-greedy strip that only removes the last hyphen-delimited segment. For 'new-york-city-2026-03-15', it produced 'new-york-city-2026-03' instead of 'new-york-city'. Using the captured PLAN_DATE variable ensures the exact date suffix is stripped.

tasks_completed.description: Fixed date fallback to use file modification date instead of today's date
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: using today's date for files without date suffix (e.g. china-exchange-bucket-list-2026.html) creates a new version directory every deployment. Using the file's mtime provides a stable, deterministic date.

tasks_completed.description: Added dedup logic to remove old versions before deploying new version
tasks_completed.changes: Added rm -rf of existing destination slug directory before mkdir in both gh-pages deploy (before line 284) and local deploy (before line 538)
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: no cleanup of previous versions meant destinations accumulated multiple date directories over time. Now each deploy removes the entire destination directory first, ensuring only one version exists.

tasks_completed.description: Extracted generate_index_html() shared function to eliminate ~80 lines of duplication
tasks_completed.changes: Created generate_index_html() function that takes target_dir parameter. Replaced both gh-pages index generation (lines 344-432) and local deploy index generation (lines 559-641) with single function calls. Uses PLAN_COUNT_PLACEHOLDER + sed for dynamic count injection since heredoc is single-quoted.
tasks_completed.rationale: DRY principle - identical HTML generation logic was duplicated. Single function ensures consistency between gh-pages and local deploy index pages.

tasks_completed.description: Lowered file size validation threshold from 100KB to 50KB
tasks_completed.changes: Changed FILE_SIZE threshold from 100000 to 50000 bytes
tasks_completed.rationale: Valid plans like the china-feb plan are only 88KB. The 100KB threshold was too aggressive and would reject legitimate plans.

tasks_completed.description: Cleaned gh-pages branch to remove duplicate versions
tasks_completed.changes: Removed 5 old date directories from gh-pages branch: beijing-exchange-bucket-list/2026-02-02, beijing-exchange-bucket-list/2026-02-10, china-exchange-bucket-list/2026-02-10, china-feb-15-mar-7-2026/2026-02-02, china-feb-15-mar-7-2026/2026-02-10. Regenerated index.html. Pushed commit 27f6cac.
tasks_completed.rationale: gh-pages had accumulated 3 versions per destination over multiple deploys. Cleaned to match the dedup behavior now built into the script.

git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Script created new date directories on each deploy without removing old ones. Combined with date fallback using today's date, this created new directories each run.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Dedup removes old versions before deploy. Date fallback uses file mtime for stability. Slug extraction correctly handles multi-hyphen names.
